meta.rolesSemantics: Candidate-slot starter is highest league-start player per fixed position; backup is secondary candidate slot even when historical co-starter. 2 CB starters and up to 1 backup; 2 CM starters and up to 1 backup provisionally. Historical actual formation exception may change positions/CM/CAM eligibility at signoff.
